text:
maria: hey @devex — running into a weird parity issue in the sampleapp rerank pipeline. Node SDK returns 1536-d embeddings, Python returns 1024-d, rerank helper expects 1024 -> downstream crash. auth/retry also seems to cause duplicate calls in batch. low bandwidth repro below, anyone seen this? :frowning:

jasper: do we have the model + sdk versions? could be model variant mismatch or quantization path differences. :eyes:

maria: both configured to `open-embed-1024` in app config. environment shows REDWOOD_EMBED_Q=1 on the container (we use q-aware selector in node). node sdk ends up with `open-embed-1536-q4` at runtime. python path falls back to a compact 1024 binary. reproducer: sending 3 inputs in a single batch triggers it. sample payload:```json
{
  "model": "open-embed-1024",
  "inputs": ["a","b","c"],
  "batch_size": 3
}
```
node observed response snippet:```json
{"vectors": [[...1536 floats...],[...1536 floats...],[...1536 floats...]] , "model": "open-embed-1536-q4"}
```
python observed:```json
{"vectors": [[...1024 floats...],[...1024 floats...],[...1024 floats...]] , "model": "open-embed-1024"}
```

maria: auth/retry wrinkle: when token expires mid-batch we see two requests in logs for the same batch. first attempt returns 401, token refreshed, retry replays the entire batch -> results duplicated in downstream buffer, so rerank helper sees 6 vectors (3x1024 + 3x1536) and throws on shape mismatch.

jasper: ugh. sounds like two problems: model selection parity and retry idempotency. for retry, is the SDK attaching an idempotency key? iirc we added support but maybe not for batch embed endpoints.

maria: correct — node sets `Idempotency-Key` per request, but the batch splitter in sampleapp splits at a higher layer and sends multiple HTTP requests without consistent idempotency per logical batch. python sampleapp uses a single HTTP call so dodge the issue.

eva: quick mitigation: dedupe at the rerank helper before reshape, and log both `vector_dim` and `model` from the embed response. long term: SDK should return explicit `vector_dim` in the response envelope plus `model_id` so callers don't guess by length. also make idempotency key generation stable per logical input id. pseudo-fix:```js
// dedupe by input-id before reshape
const unique = new Map();
responses.forEach(r => { if (!unique.has(r.id)) unique.set(r.id, r); });
const vectors = Array.from(unique.values()).map(r=>r.vector);
```

maria: logs:```
[2026-03-22T14:10:12Z] POST /v1/embeddings batch_id=bat-314 token=expired 401
[2026-03-22T14:10:13Z] token refreshed by auth-agent
[2026-03-22T14:10:13Z] RETRY POST /v1/embeddings batch_id=bat-314 idempotency=none 200 model=open-embed-1536-q4
[2026-03-22T14:10:13Z] also got callback from python-runner: model=open-embed-1024 200
```

jasper: ok. immediate plan: 1) patch sampleapp batching helper to attach a deterministic idempotency key per logical batch, 2) add defensive dedupe in rerank helper, 3) file SDK parity bug for model selection in Node quant path. 4) add unit test that mixes quantized and non-quantized responses to assert reshape fails early with a helpful error.

maria: will open the PRs. re: SDK bug i'm gonna add a small integration test that asserts `response.vector_dim` exists and equals 1024 for the configured model.

devex-bot: deploy-bot: canary 2.14.7 rolled to dev cluster at 2026-03-22T14:12:00Z — watch for embed-service errors.

sre-ops: watching logs, set a 5xx alert on rerank-helper for the next 2hrs. reach out if error rate > 0.5% :ok_hand:

eva: also shorthand note for docs: "embedding responses include `model` and `vector_dim` fields; do not rely on vector length inference." i'll add to SDK migration guide.

maria: thanks all — I'll ping this thread with PR links. :thumbsup:
